# SujithSoft

> SujithSoft is the software studio of Sujith Shalitha Dassanayake, making fast, private desktop apps for Windows. Home: https://sujithshalitha.github.io/

## S Converter

> S Converter is a free, offline, all-in-one file converter for Windows 10 and 11, made by Sujith Shalitha Dassanayake. It converts images, video, audio, documents, PDFs and archives in batches on the user's own PC. Files are never uploaded, and it needs no account.

- Website: https://sujithshalitha.github.io/s-converter/
- In Sinhala (සිංහල): https://sujithshalitha.github.io/s-converter/si/
- Microsoft Store: https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9NKD1BD2RM1X (installs without a SmartScreen warning; updated by the Store)
- Download (latest installer): https://github.com/SujithShalitha/s-converter-releases/releases/latest
- Price: free, no ads, no watermark on output files
- Platform: Windows 10 (1809 or newer) and Windows 11, 64-bit. Not available for macOS, Linux, Android or iOS.
- Latest version: 1.0.8, released 19 October 2026. Changelog: https://github.com/SujithShalitha/s-converter-releases/releases
- Developer: SujithSoft (Sujith Shalitha Dassanayake), Sri Lanka
- Official channels: https://www.youtube.com/@SujithSoft and https://www.facebook.com/SujithSoft
- Name: several unrelated products are called "S Converter" or "SConverter" (for example an Android unit converter). This one is the Windows file converter by SujithSoft, Microsoft Store ID 9NKD1BD2RM1X.

### What it does

- Images: JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, TIFF, GIF, BMP, SVG, HEIC/HEIF (iPhone) and camera RAW (CR2, NEF, ARW, DNG, RAF, ORF, RW2) to JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, TIFF, GIF or PDF. Resize, compress, presets (Email, Instagram, Web, Thumbnail).
- Video: MP4, MKV, AVI, MOV, WMV, FLV, WebM, MPEG, M4V, 3GP, TS, VOB, MTS/M2TS, OGV to MP4, MKV, AVI, MOV, WebM, GIF, WMV, FLV, MPEG, 3GP, TS. GPU encoding on NVIDIA, Intel and AMD. Trim, resize, make GIFs, extract audio.
- Audio: MP3, WAV, FLAC, AAC, OGG, WMA, M4A, AIFF, Opus, AMR, AC3 (and audio from any video) to MP3, WAV, FLAC, AAC, OGG, M4A, Opus, AIFF, WMA, AC3, AMR.
- Documents, without Microsoft Office or LibreOffice: DOCX, DOC, ODT, RTF, TXT, Markdown, HTML, EPUB, PPTX, PPT, ODP, XLSX, XLS, ODS, CSV to PDF, DOCX, ODT, RTF, HTML, TXT, Markdown, XLSX.
- PDF tools: images to PDF, PDF to images, merge, split, compress, rotate, add page numbers, extract pages.
- Watermarks: text or logo on photos and videos, with a live preview.
- Archives: create ZIP, 7Z, RAR (needs WinRAR) and TAR.GZ, with passwords (ZIP uses AES-256); extract ZIP, 7Z, RAR, TAR, ISO, CAB.
- Quick Convert: select files in File Explorer, press Ctrl+Alt+C or right-click > Quick Convert, and pick a format on a wheel.
- Updates install automatically in the background.

## Guides

- [Convert HEIC to JPG on Windows](https://sujithshalitha.github.io/s-converter/heic-to-jpg/): Convert iPhone HEIC photos to JPG on Windows 10 and 11 in batches, for free and without uploading them. S Converter also turns HEIC into PNG, WebP or PDF.
- [Convert WebP to JPG or PNG on Windows](https://sujithshalitha.github.io/s-converter/webp-to-jpg/): Turn WebP images saved from websites into JPG or PNG on Windows, in batches, offline and free. Also converts AVIF, TIFF, BMP and GIF.
- [Convert JPG and other images to PDF on Windows](https://sujithshalitha.github.io/s-converter/jpg-to-pdf/): Combine JPG, PNG and other images into one PDF, or make one PDF per image, on Windows. Free, offline, with pages in the order you choose.
- [Convert PDF pages to JPG images on Windows](https://sujithshalitha.github.io/s-converter/pdf-to-jpg/): Save every page of a PDF as a JPG image on Windows 10 and 11. Free, offline, works on several PDFs at once.
- [Convert Word to PDF without Microsoft Office](https://sujithshalitha.github.io/s-converter/word-to-pdf/): Convert DOCX and DOC files to PDF on Windows without Microsoft Office or LibreOffice. Keeps headings, lists, tables, pictures and links. Free and offline.
- [Convert PowerPoint to PDF without Office](https://sujithshalitha.github.io/s-converter/powerpoint-to-pdf/): Turn PPTX presentations into PDF on Windows without PowerPoint. Each slide keeps its layout, pictures and colours. Free and offline.
- [Compress a PDF on Windows, offline](https://sujithshalitha.github.io/s-converter/compress-pdf/): Make PDFs smaller on Windows to email or upload them, while keeping text sharp. Free, works offline, handles several PDFs at once.
- [Merge PDF files on Windows](https://sujithshalitha.github.io/s-converter/merge-pdf/): Combine several PDFs into one file on Windows, in the order you choose. Free, offline, no upload, no page limits.
- [Convert MKV to MP4 on Windows](https://sujithshalitha.github.io/s-converter/mkv-to-mp4/): Convert MKV videos to MP4 on Windows using your NVIDIA, Intel or AMD graphics card for speed. Free, offline, batch conversion.
- [Extract MP3 audio from a video on Windows](https://sujithshalitha.github.io/s-converter/video-to-mp3/): Pull the sound out of MP4, MKV, MOV and other videos as MP3 on Windows. Free, offline, with trimming and bitrate options.
- [Make a GIF from a video on Windows](https://sujithshalitha.github.io/s-converter/video-to-gif/): Turn a video clip into an animated GIF on Windows. Trim it to the moment you want, then convert. Free and offline.
- [Resize and compress photos in bulk on Windows](https://sujithshalitha.github.io/s-converter/resize-images/): Shrink and resize many photos at once on Windows for email, websites or storage. Set a maximum width and quality. Free and offline.
- [Compress a photo to under 100 KB on Windows](https://sujithshalitha.github.io/s-converter/compress-image-to-100kb/): Make a JPG under 100 KB, 50 KB, 200 KB or any size you need for an upload form, on Windows 10 and 11. Batch, offline and free, with the best quality that fits.
- [Make a US visa photo: 600 × 600 px, under 240 KB](https://sujithshalitha.github.io/s-converter/us-visa-photo/): Turn any photo into a US visa or DV lottery photo on Windows: a square 600 × 600 pixel JPG under 240 KB, cropped around the face. Free, offline, no upload.
- [Resize a photo for a passport or ID form (35 × 45 mm)](https://sujithshalitha.github.io/s-converter/passport-photo-size/): Resize and crop a photo to 35 × 45 mm, 2 × 2 inch or any pixel size and KB limit for passport, ID and exam applications, on Windows. Free and offline.
- [Compress a video to under 20 MB for email](https://sujithshalitha.github.io/s-converter/compress-video-for-email/): Make a video small enough to email, under 20 MB, 25 MB or any size, on Windows 10 and 11. S Converter works out the bitrate from the length. Free and offline.
- [Convert a screenshot or copied image to JPG, straight from the clipboard](https://sujithshalitha.github.io/s-converter/screenshot-to-jpg/): Convert a screenshot or an image you copied into JPG, WebP or PDF without saving it first, then paste the result anywhere. Free and offline, for Windows 10 and 11.
- [Compress a video for Discord (under 10 MB)](https://sujithshalitha.github.io/s-converter/compress-video-for-discord/): Make a video fit Discord’s 10 MB upload limit on Windows 11 and 10, keeping it as sharp as possible. Free, offline, no watermark, no upload to a website first.

## Tutorials

How to use S Converter's features, step by step. Index: https://sujithshalitha.github.io/s-converter/tutorials/

- [Getting started with S Converter](https://sujithshalitha.github.io/s-converter/tutorials/getting-started/): Install S Converter on Windows 10 or 11 and convert your first files: adding files, picking a format, choosing where files are saved and finding the results.
- [Quick Convert: convert files without opening the app](https://sujithshalitha.github.io/s-converter/tutorials/quick-convert/): Select files in File Explorer, press Ctrl+Alt+C, and pick a format on the wheel that opens at your mouse. How the Quick Convert wheel works in S Converter.
- [Convert files from the right-click menu](https://sujithshalitha.github.io/s-converter/tutorials/right-click-menu/): Right-click photos, videos, documents, PDFs, archives or folders in File Explorer and convert, compress, zip or extract them with S Converter.
- [One-click presets: Email, Instagram, WhatsApp and more](https://sujithshalitha.github.io/s-converter/tutorials/one-click-presets/): Resize photos for email or Instagram, shrink videos for WhatsApp, make GIFs and ringtones with one click in S Converter.
- [Make a video small enough for WhatsApp or email](https://sujithshalitha.github.io/s-converter/tutorials/compress-video/): Shrink a large video on Windows so it fits WhatsApp, email or a website upload: 720p or 480p MP4, using your graphics card, offline and free.
- [Add a watermark to photos and videos](https://sujithshalitha.github.io/s-converter/tutorials/watermark/): Put your name, logo or © text on photos and videos in batches with S Converter: drag it into place, set the size, colour and opacity, and see the result live.
- [Trim a video or audio file](https://sujithshalitha.github.io/s-converter/tutorials/trim/): Cut the start and end off a video or song with S Converter’s visual trimmer: drag two handles, play it back, and save just the part you want.
- [Zip a folder with a password, and extract archives](https://sujithshalitha.github.io/s-converter/tutorials/zip-password/): Make a password-protected ZIP of any folder on Windows with S Converter, and extract ZIP, 7Z, RAR and TAR.GZ files with a right-click.
- [Split, rotate, number and extract PDF pages](https://sujithshalitha.github.io/s-converter/tutorials/pdf-tools/): Split a PDF into pages or ranges, rotate pages, add page numbers and keep only the pages you need, offline on Windows with S Converter’s PDF tools.
- [Settings: themes, GPU speed, output folder and updates](https://sujithshalitha.github.io/s-converter/tutorials/settings/): Make S Converter yours: choose one of four themes and your language, use your graphics card for faster video, set the default output folder and quality, and change the Quick Convert shortcut.
- [Save your own presets](https://sujithshalitha.github.io/s-converter/tutorials/my-presets/): Save the format and settings you use most as your own one-click preset in S Converter, then use it from the app or the Quick Convert wheel.
- [Remove location and camera details from photos and videos](https://sujithshalitha.github.io/s-converter/tutorials/private-copy/): Photos and videos can carry your GPS location, camera and date. Make a private copy without them in one click with S Converter, offline on Windows.
- [Rename a batch of files as you convert](https://sujithshalitha.github.io/s-converter/tutorials/batch-rename/): Give converted files tidy names like Holiday-001, 002, 003 or 2026-08-14 Beach, with S Converter’s Rename tool. Free and offline for Windows.
- [Lock a PDF with a password, or unlock one](https://sujithshalitha.github.io/s-converter/tutorials/lock-pdf/): Add a password to a PDF with AES-256 encryption, or remove the password from a PDF you can open, with S Converter. Free, offline, no upload.
- [Watch folders: convert new files automatically](https://sujithshalitha.github.io/s-converter/tutorials/watch-folders/): Point S Converter at a folder, like Screenshots or Downloads, and every new file is converted automatically. Plus the conversion history.
- [Use S Converter in your language](https://sujithshalitha.github.io/s-converter/tutorials/languages/): S Converter speaks 20 languages, including Sinhala, Spanish, German, French, Hindi, Japanese, Korean and Chinese. How to change the language.
- [Make files fit a size limit](https://sujithshalitha.github.io/s-converter/tutorials/make-it-fit/): Use S Converter’s Max size to make photos under 100 KB and videos under 20 MB, and Form photo for visa, passport and exam photos at an exact pixel size.
- [Recipes: convert, rename and pack in one click](https://sujithshalitha.github.io/s-converter/tutorials/recipes/): Build an S Converter recipe that converts files, renames them with a pattern and packs them into one ZIP or one PDF, in a single click from the app or the wheel.
- [Paste as…: convert the clipboard image](https://sujithshalitha.github.io/s-converter/tutorials/paste-as/): Convert a screenshot or copied image to JPG, PNG or WebP straight from the clipboard with S Converter’s Quick Convert shortcut, and paste the result anywhere.

## Comparisons

- [S Converter vs online file converters](https://sujithshalitha.github.io/s-converter/compare/online-converters/): Online converters like CloudConvert, Convertio and FreeConvert upload your files to a server. S Converter converts them on your own PC. Here’s how the two compare on privacy, speed, limits and price.
- [The best free file converters for Windows](https://sujithshalitha.github.io/s-converter/compare/best-free-converters/): An honest look at free, offline file converters for Windows: S Converter, HandBrake, Format Factory, XnConvert and LibreOffice, and which one fits which job.

## Documentation

The full user guide. Source on GitHub: https://github.com/SujithShalitha/s-converter-releases/tree/main/docs

- [S Converter documentation](https://sujithshalitha.github.io/s-converter/docs/): Everything S Converter can do, step by step. Convert images, video, audio, documents and PDFs on Windows, offline, and learn Quick Convert, recipes, form photos and more.
- [Install and update S Converter](https://sujithshalitha.github.io/s-converter/docs/install/): How to install S Converter on Windows 10 or 11 from the Microsoft Store or GitHub, what the "Windows protected your PC" message means, and how updates work.
- [Convert files with S Converter](https://sujithshalitha.github.io/s-converter/docs/convert/): How to convert images, video, audio and documents in S Converter's main window. Add files, choose a format and quality, pick where files are saved, and read the results.
- [Quick Convert wheel](https://sujithshalitha.github.io/s-converter/docs/quick-convert/): Convert files without opening S Converter. Select files in File Explorer, on the desktop or in an Open/Save dialog, or copy an image, then press Ctrl+Alt+C and pick a format on the wheel.
- [S Converter in the right-click menu](https://sujithshalitha.github.io/s-converter/docs/right-click/): Convert, compress or zip files and folders straight from File Explorer's right-click menu on Windows 11 and 10 with S Converter.
- [Presets and recipes](https://sujithshalitha.github.io/s-converter/docs/presets-recipes/): Use S Converter's one-click presets, save your own, and build recipes that convert, rename and pack files into one ZIP or PDF in a single click.
- [Keyboard shortcuts](https://sujithshalitha.github.io/s-converter/docs/shortcuts/): Every S Converter keyboard shortcut: the Quick Convert wheel, Presets and Repeat last keys, wheel controls, the page order screen and the preview.
- [Make it fit — file-size limits and form photos](https://sujithshalitha.github.io/s-converter/docs/make-it-fit/): Make a photo under 100 KB, a video under 20 MB for email, or a visa, passport or exam photo at the exact pixel size, with S Converter's Max size and Form photo tools.
- [Trim, watermark and rename](https://sujithshalitha.github.io/s-converter/docs/edit/): Trim videos and audio, add a text or logo watermark to photos and videos, and rename a whole batch with a pattern in S Converter.
- [PDF tools](https://sujithshalitha.github.io/s-converter/docs/pdf-tools/): Merge, split, compress, rotate, number, extract pages, lock and unlock PDFs, and turn images into PDF or PDF into images, privately on Windows with S Converter.
- [ZIP, 7Z, RAR and TAR.GZ archives](https://sujithshalitha.github.io/s-converter/docs/archives/): Zip folders, protect ZIP files with an AES-256 password, and extract ZIP, 7Z, RAR, TAR, ISO and CAB archives on Windows with S Converter.
- [Watch folders and conversion history](https://sujithshalitha.github.io/s-converter/docs/watch-history/): Make S Converter convert new files in a folder automatically, like screenshots to JPG or scans to PDF, and see everything you converted in History.
- [Privacy and private copies](https://sujithshalitha.github.io/s-converter/docs/privacy/): S Converter works offline and never uploads your files. Learn what stays on your PC and how to remove GPS location and camera details from photos and videos.
- [Settings, languages and themes](https://sujithshalitha.github.io/s-converter/docs/settings/): Every S Converter setting explained: language, output folder, quality, graphics card, Quick Convert shortcuts, right-click menu, watch folders, updates and themes.
- [Supported formats](https://sujithshalitha.github.io/s-converter/docs/formats/): Every file format S Converter reads and writes on Windows — images including HEIC and RAW, video, audio, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, PDF and archives.
- [Troubleshooting and FAQ](https://sujithshalitha.github.io/s-converter/docs/troubleshooting/): Fixes for common S Converter questions — the shortcut does nothing, a white window, Windows warnings, files that won't convert, and where files are saved.
